description: Continue contacts paused with pause_sequence_subscribers from the step they were paused on, with the status they had. Waits keep their original wall-clock time, like a whole-sequence pause: a wait that ran out while paused continues right away (so the next email can send as soon as a worker picks it up), and one that has not still ends when it would have. Contacts that are not paused are reported with outcome not_paused and left alone. When the sequence itself is disabled, sequenceRunning is false and resumed contacts continue once it is enabled. Provide sequenceId and subscriberIds, emails, or both (up to 500 combined).

companyId.description: Company ID. If not provided, uses the currently selected company.

emails.description: Subscriber email addresses to resume. Combined with subscriberIds, up to 500.

sequenceId.description: Sequence ID whose paused enrollments should resume.

subscriberIds.description: Subscriber IDs to resume. Combined with emails, up to 500.

name: resume_sequence_subscribers

outputSchema.description: Structured content returned by the `resume_sequence_subscribers` MCP tool.

appUrls.description: Dashboard URLs for relevant Sequenzy resources.

enqueueErrors.description: Resumed enrollments whose queue handoff failed. They stay resumed and are recovered by the stuck-enrollment sweeper.

items.description: One enrollmentId with its enqueue error.

enqueuedCount.description: Resumed enrollments handed to the worker queue. Zero while the sequence is not running.

enrollments.description: Every live enrollment of the targeted contacts in this sequence with its outcome: enrollmentId, subscriberId, subscriberEmail, currentNodeId, status after the call, waitUntil (when a waiting enrollment next runs), pausedAt (null unless paused), and outcome.

items.description: Fallback array wrapper used only when a tool returns a bare array.

message.description: Human-readable status, confirmation, or next-step message.

notEnrolled.description: Contacts that exist but have no active, waiting, or paused enrollment in this sequence.

notFound.description: subscriberIds and emails that match no contact in this company.

notPausedCount.description: Enrollments of the targeted contacts that were not paused (outcome not_paused) and were left alone.

sequenceRunning.description: False when the sequence itself is disabled or not live; resumed contacts then continue once it is enabled.

subscriptionUrl.description: Owner-facing subscription, upgrade, and billing-management URL when available.

url.description: Primary dashboard URL for this result.

value.description: Fallback object wrapper used only when a tool returns a non-object value.

warnings.description: Non-fatal cautions about content, permissions, or follow-up actions.
